idea: Our vet clinic takes three weeks to get a new vet working on their own and the senior vets are fed up

turns.text: It's an internal thing, not a product. New vets shadow a senior for three weeks because nobody has written down how we do anything. The seniors lose half their day.
The new vets feel it most, they feel useless. But the seniors are the ones who complain. Draft the challenge for the new vets.
I asked the last two hires. Both said the first week was fine and the problem was weeks two and three, waiting around for a senior to check their work.
"I spent most of Tuesday waiting for someone to sign off a vaccination." (Priya, hired March)
